name: Moonlit Reunion
description: Mei Zhuyu, a calm and reserved nobleman from a lesser branch of the Mei family, arrives in Chang'an as an official at the Bureau of Mystic Investigations. During a banquet, he meets Wu Zhen, the bold and unruly younger sister of the Empress and secret Guardian of the Demon Underworld. Both hide their true identities. Wu, a half-demon striving to keep peace, and Mei, a skilled demon slayer, seek the truth behind the fire 18 years ago. As bone demons rise and unrest grows, they fight side by side, forming a bond that deepens into love until the Changxi Palace launches a purge, forcing them to face each other's secrets and the past they share.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Cat Lord Wu Zhen traps a demon while Mei Zhuyu exposes his priesthood—their paths cross again.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Wu Zhen seizes the Female Bat and learns its loss of sanity is tied to the cursed Bone Relic.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: At the banquet, Mei and Wu expose Xie Loubai's lantern trick, trapping the Shadow Demon.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Discovering the Bone Relic in Mei Zhuyu's possession, Wu Zhen prepares to steal it.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Wu fails to break the bone. Elder Hui colludes with Shan Posuo; Wu and Mei search the Hills.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Ling Xiao and Wu Zi Shu expose Elder Hui's plot, while Mei Zhuyu and Wu Zi Shu destroy Shan Posuo.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Mei Zhuyu returns to petition for the Bureau Chief position. Hu Zhu tests Shuang Jiang's identity.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Hu Zhu and Shuang Jiang confront a demon while Mei and Wu Zhen discover odd camellias in the palace.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Mei and Wu investigate a case of spirit-princess while Elder Hui conspires with Xuan Hui.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Xuan Hui attacks the city. Mei is injured protecting Wu Zhen. Liu defeats the demon.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Wu Zhen confirms Xuan Hui's attack and heals Mei Zhuyu. Mei gradually develops feelings for her.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Wu Zhen defeats Elder Hui in the Demon Underworld by using Cat Lord powers in the mortal duel.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Wu Zhen repairs the Demon Underworld's barrier, unknowingly clashing with Mei in disguise.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Mei moves out of the Wu residence, encounters bandits, and falls victim to Pei Jiya's poisoning.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Mei stays in Chang'an to investigate Pei while Wu Zhen joins the Scented Duel with others.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Anbilo kills for incense. Mei's rescue of Wu Zhen reveals his secret abilities, making Pei doubt.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Mei Si accidentally summons ink demons that Mei Zhuyu destroys, while Wu Zhen discovers Xuan Hui.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: When Pei Jiya proposes to Wu Zhen, Mei becomes suspicious and discovers his dark practices.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: At Lin'an River, Pei's exposed identity traps Wu Zhen and Mei Zhuyu in a deadly choice.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Mei Zhu Yu and Wu Zhen are caught in the formation. After confessing his love to Wu Zhen, Mei Zhu Yu pushes her out of the stalagmite formation, while he plummets to the depth below.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Wu Zi Shu knocks out Wu Zhen with a spell and brings her back to the Demon City. He asks Wu Zhen why she fell in love with a mortal.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Chang Ming wants to appoint Mei Zhu Yu as the Head Administrator of the sect. Mei Zhu Yu declines his offer. He intends to leave the sect and get married. The other sect members are dumbfounded.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Under Chang Ming's request, Mei Zhu Yu leaves behind the Changxi Truncheon. He leaves the sect after that. Meanwhile, Wu Zhen is absent-minded due to Mei Zhu Yu's long absence.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Mei Zhu Yu and Wu Zhen are finally married. On their wedding day, guests gather to witness the ceremony.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: When the dream demon invades Ling Xiao's dream, Wu Zhen catches it red-handed. The demon isn't willing to return to the Demon City with Wu Zhen. Thus, it causes her to have a dream within a dream.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: At night, Wu Zhen detects that something's off about her body. She sneaks out of the Mei Residence to find Wu Zi Shu. Wu Zi Shu tells her that he has a way to turn her into a full demon.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Liu Tai Zhen tells Wu Zhen that the Skin Shop is preparing a skin for her. Wu Zhen finds out that the price to pay for becoming a complete demon is to give up on her original body and cultivate in seclusion for 50 years.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Wu Zi Shu encourages Hu Zhu to find Shuang Jiang to verify his identity, intentionally leading her into the hands of Chang Ming and his fellow exorcists. Chang Ming strikes Hu Zhu off a cliff. Shuang Jiang leaps down after her.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Under the pretence of catching a cheating spouse, Wu Zhen claims that Mei Zhu Yu is her husband. The two put on an act for Chang Ming Lian Fu. Chang Ming then reveals that the Divine Fire from 18 years ago was caused by the Demon City, and tells Mei Zhu Yu that he should avenge his parents.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Wu Zhen asks Wu Zi Shu if he knew that Mei Zhu Yu was related to Changxi Palace long ago. Wu Zi Shu confesses. Mei Zhu Yu returns to the Mei Residence. Everything has changed. He doesn't know what to do.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Liu Tai Zhen is in a hurry to get her body back. Thus, she frequents the Mei Residence to seek Mei Zhu Yu's help. The public witnesses her visits. They gossip about the relationship between her and Mei Zhu Yu. Wu Chun Dao and Liu Gong Shen head to the Mei Residence to investigate the affair. They see their intimate behavior. Liu Gong Shen faints out of spite.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Wu Zi Shu is shoved aside by Mei Zhu Yu. Wu Zhen uses her last bit of conscience to suppress the core inside her body. Wu Zi Shu wants to check on Wu Zhen but Mei Zhu Yu stops him and blames Wu Zi Shu for almost killing Wu Zhen.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Wu Zhen and Mei Zhu Yu try to inquire about the location of the Zhuyu Divine Herb. They come across a mysterious residence. The guests meet Physician Gu one by one, hoping to fulfill their wishes.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Elder Gray obtains the demon core from the book warehouse and attempts to kill Wu Zhen and release the Satanic Fiend when Wu Zi Shu is restrained from leaving Demon City but Wu Zi Shu notices. Mei Zhu Yu brings Wu Zhen back to Changxi Palace.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Demonic ulcers appear on Wu Zhen's arm again. Mei Zhu Yu knows that there's not much time left. He decides to risk his life. He utilizes an artifact to travel back 18 years in time.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Wu Zhen wakes up with every member of Changxi Palace present besides Mei Zhu Yu. Wu Zi Shu and Elder Gray work together to achieve their respective goals.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Elder Gray forces Liu Tai Zhen to remove her scale. After Wu Zhen finds out, she discusses with Huan Zhu and Wu Zi Shu to find out which location requires the Cat Lord's blood and Serpent Lord's scale to gain access to. In the end, she's reminded of an abandoned warehouse.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Elder Gray dumps the origin power into the ruined temple's well and plans to destroy Chang'an. Liu Tai Zhen and the rest suppress the sinister force of the well from the Demon City. Everyone from Changxi Palace works together to control the well but they cannot stop the sinister force from spreading.
